subject: forge-api 2026-10-01: opening a run session now requires the policy version

body.summary: Opening a run session must now say which version of the dispatch policy decided to take the work, so every run records the policy it was taken under.

changes.text: The request body gains a required field, policyVersion: the full commit of the driver plugin that chose the work. A request without it is refused with 422 and the code POLICY_VERSION_REQUIRED.
The response may carry a new optional field, changeScope. Readers that ignore unknown fields are unaffected.

body.migration: Send policyVersion on every run-session open, set to the plugin commit your box runs. Until 2026-10-09 the field is accepted but not required, so a client can be updated first and deployed before the change takes effect.
